summary: Tests-only PR: local-stub regression coverage was added for manifest and recent-sheet reads. The container has no Swift toolchain, and generated-client implementation is intentionally deferred to the next phase.

references.result: Upstream issue is closed; its current main commit 47057afd58f7d46b4d4b740ca7d2d08947774471 serves /api/v1/openapi.json. iOS dependency and vendoring work has not started in this tests-only phase.
Defines the six generated-operation stub tests; ranked-results and generated operation wiring await implementation.
Hand-written API models remain present by design in this tests-only phase.
Local URLProtocol stubs cover manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, and judgment upload; tests could not run because swift is unavailable in this container.
Records prose-contract deltas, unsupported schema precision, and the ranked-results endpoint gap against upstream commit 47057afd58f7d46b4d4b740ca7d2d08947774471.
